shellCommands.command:
rm -f books.json && (node server.mjs &>/tmp/server.log & echo $! > /tmp/server.pid) && sleep 1 && \
curl -s localhost:3000/ | grep -E 'Nothing on the go|No finished' && \
curl -s -X POST localhost:3000/books -d 'title=Dune&author=Frank+Herbert&notes=Fear+is+the+mind-killer.' -o /dev/null -w 'add: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n'

ID=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('books.json','utf8'))[0].id)") && echo "id=$ID" && \
curl -s localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -E '<h1>|author|notes' && \
curl -s -X POST localhost:3000/books/$ID/finish -o /dev/null -w 'finish: %{http_code}\n' && \
curl -s localhost:3000/ | grep -A3 '<h2>Finished' && \
kill $(cat /tmp/server.pid) && sleep 0.3 && node server.mjs &>/tmp/server2.log & sleep 1.5 && curl -s localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -E '<h1>|Finished'

pkill -f 'node server.mjs'; sleep 0.3; (node server.mjs &>/tmp/server3.log &); sleep 1; ID=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('books.json','utf8'))[0].id)"); curl -s localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -E '<h1>|middot'; pkill -f 'node server.mjs'

cat /tmp/server3.log; ID=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('books.json','utf8'))[0].id)"); (node server.mjs &>/tmp/server4.log &); sleep 1; curl -s localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -E '<h1>|middot'; curl -s localhost:3000/ | grep -c 'Finished it'; pkill -f 'node server.mjs'; true
